target: BSSA research article; editorial significance is not guaranteed by technical completion
authorization: Latest user request authorizes bounded local research, tests and manuscript improvement, and declines new label review. It does not authorize external publication or submission.

experiment_a.purpose: Test whether a standard first-order constrained filter explains the apparent neural preservation/rejection tradeoff in the archived Ricker component design.
experiment_a.source: All eight existing development_outcomes adapter arrays and all original case tables; immutable SHA256 inventory required before run.
experiment_a.added_method: LCMV with context_0.25 covariance and the same 0.001 mean-diagonal loading
experiment_a.constraints: At every active Fourier bin C=[a,q*a], C^H*w=[1,0], q=(channel_index-15.5)/15.5. This protects an affine amplitude gradient exactly and affine phase gradients to first order, not arbitrary response uncertainty.
experiment_a.design: Every original cutoff, aperture, assumed delay, central frequency and response condition; no replacement or exclusion.
experiment_a.report: All ten methods, every condition and every date. Preserve the original nine-method frontier as historical and label the ten-method frontier as the new extension, not a changed primary result. No new winning policy or utility threshold.

experiment_b.purpose: A controlled recorded-component transplantation stress test; not clean-earthquake recovery or arrival validation.
experiment_b.selection: All two source-classified T event examples in the four HDF examples shipped in the cached public release. Eligibility uses metadata only, before sample decoding. No output-based selection.
experiment_b.window: Detection time minus 2 through plus 5 seconds; native start is the first sample not earlier than the left boundary. Exactly 1750 native samples. Preserve all 381 ROI channels 4000:5900:5; offset-safe crop-local 1/10 resampling and linear detrend give 175x381 samples.
experiment_b.timing: Source samples are digitally transplanted on the target relative-time grid. Crop-local resampling does not claim to preserve the source file's global 25-Hz grid or source origin timing. No phase picks or waveform centering/fitting.
experiment_b.nominal_response: Catalog-origin AK135 earliest S/s horizontal slowness at each of the eight unchanged measured-geometry aperture centers. No fitting to template or output. This is a modeled response, not observed S truth; source crop is detection-centered, not S-centered.
experiment_b.sources_are_not_clean: Each source component retains its recorded ambient signals and instrument response. One source recording additionally includes a catalog F detection later outside the fixed crop; metadata are retained. No assertion of isolated earthquake purity.
experiment_b.apertures: All eight unchanged 32-channel apertures; original starts retained and validated.
experiment_b.weights: Reuse archived background-past contexts and neural/ridge kernels; no source component or future background enters weight construction. Same ordinary MVDR helper, except declared additional LCMV constraint. No checkpoint refitting.
experiment_b.amplitude_rule: Retain original source count units. Do not sweep amplitude: fixed-weight component-ratio gain and normalized distortion are scale-invariant. Report component powers and input ratios, not clean SNR.
experiment_b.reference: Conventional steered sum of the same band-limited recorded component. This declared linear reference is NOT a clean ground-motion waveform and gives conventional zero reference error by definition.
metrics: normalized squared difference from the conventional component reference
component output power relative to conventional dB
experiment_b.reference_cancellation: Retain and report reference/input component power ratio for every source and aperture. No cancellation-based outcome exclusion. Nonpositive reference power stops the complete analysis rather than silently dropping cases.
experiment_b.linearity_check: For every case verify filter(source+background)=filter(source)+filter(background) numerically. Independently replay summaries and a deterministic representative set with direct DFT calculations.
experiment_b.aggregation: Retain source x background-date summaries (2x4) and hour-level values. Sources and background dates are crossed, not independent 8 earthquake-date pairs. Two earthquakes share one source day; no population CI, pseudo-replicated significance test or independent external generalization claim.

failure_policy: Stop and record any input hash mismatch, missing planned case, invalid solver, nonfinite metric or nonpositive component/reference power. Never drop cases, fit steering, change reference, add models or widen source windows after outcomes.
stopping_point: Complete these two fixed panels once, retain all outcomes, independently verify their numerics, integrate supported findings, package reproducibility and compile/visually inspect the submission candidate. No further model or data search to obtain a favorable verdict.
external_actions: No push, public archive publication, journal submission, email or paid compute without explicit approval.
